paper_title: Normal Sequences with Non-Maximal Automatic Complexity
classifications: Theory of computation → Formal languages and automata theory
statement: ▶ Question 13. Let C ∈ PSC satisfy Theorem 11. Is there a limit to the number of beneficial loops we can use to ensure prefixes of C are uniquely accepted? Finding the value of I(C) is left as an open question. For instance, is I(C) > 0?
context: Similar results to the above proposition can be shown for n even also. For instance, if n is a power of 2, loops of length larger than n in zone Cn have to be a multiple of 2n − 1.
